Callout.Name: Assault on a Bus
Callout.Message: Passenger assaulted on a bus, driver holding the vehicle.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect on board, victim with staff, no weapon seen.

Script.Line: He put his bag on my legs. That is how it started.
Ask the driver. The driver saw all of it.
I want him arrested as well. Both of us, that is fair.

Lines.Approach: The driver has stopped the bus and the suspect is still on it. Victim is with the other passengers.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
